quarterly_data.signal: AXT's 10-Q states that as of June 30, 2026 the aggregate transaction price allocated to the remaining performance obligations under its long-term supply agreements was approximately $98.5 million, excluding applicable taxes, which AXT expects to recognize as revenue through the first half of 2029 as the products are delivered. The agreements require aggregate contractual advance payments of approximately $47.7 million, of which approximately $12.7 million had been received as of June 30, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO under long-term supply agreements ~$98.5 million (as of June 30, 2026), recognized through the first half of 2029; advance payments ~$47.7 million, ~$12.7 million received
